plotExpectedFootprint

Source: R/plots.R
plotExpectedFootprint.Rd

Plot the observed methylation profile around the binding sites of one motif together with the profile expected from GC content.

Usage

plotExpectedFootprint(
  motif,
  tf_bindsites,
  msites,
  sample_name = NULL,
  gc_dist,
  gcfreqs,
  enhancer = NULL,
  returnPlotData = FALSE
)

Arguments

motif

Name of the motif, one of names(tf_bindsites).

tf_bindsites

A GRangesList named by motif. Each element is a GRanges of the occurrences of that motif. The names must include every name in names(gcfreqs). Get it with getTFbindsites(motifSet = "jaspar2020") from the methylTFRAnnotationHg38 (or methylTFRAnnotationMm10) package, or build a custom set with methylTFRAnnotationBuilder.

msites

A GRanges object with one range per CpG (width 1) and the metadata columns score (numeric methylation fraction between 0 and 1) and coverage (read count). Usually produced by readMethylome.

sample_name

Optional sample label used in the plot title. Default "sample".

gc_dist

A GRanges object of 30-bp genomic windows with an integer metadata column GC_bin (1 to 5). Get it with getGenomeGC() from the annotation package.

gcfreqs

A named list with one element per motif, named as in tf_bindsites. Each element is a numeric matrix with the five GC bins in rows and the positions across the binding-site window in columns. Get it with getGCfreq(motifSet = ...) from the annotation package.

enhancer

An optional GRanges object of regions, for example distal regulatory elements. Binding sites outside these regions are dropped. Any region set imported as GRanges works, for example the ENCODE candidate cis-regulatory elements (SCREEN) read with rtracklayer::import(). Default NULL uses all binding sites.

returnPlotData

Logical. If TRUE, return the plot data as well as the plot.

Value

A ggplot object, or, if returnPlotData is TRUE, a list with the elements plot and plotDF.

See also

plotMotifFootprint for the bias-corrected profile, computeDeviation for the score it summarises.

Examples

load(system.file("extdata", "BATF_tf_bindsites.rda", package = "methylTFR"))
load(system.file("extdata", "example_data.rda", package = "methylTFR"))
load(system.file("extdata", "BATF_gcfreqs.rda", package = "methylTFR"))
load(system.file("extdata", "gcdist_subset.rda", package = "methylTFR"))

p <- plotExpectedFootprint(
    motif = "BATF",
    tf_bindsites = tf_bindsites,
    msites = msites,
    sample_name = "Sample1",
    gc_dist = gcdist,
    gcfreqs = gcfreqs,
    enhancer = NULL,
    returnPlotData = FALSE
)
